title: Instant Server Switcher
description: Instantly switch between your last or two fixed Minecraft servers with a single key press.
body:
# 🌐 Instant Server Switcher

Switch between your last or fixed Minecraft servers with a single key — with optional auto-fallback to your main server when disconnected.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔁 **Quick Server Toggle** — Instantly switch between the last two servers you joined with one hotkey.
- ⚙️ **Fixed Servers Mode** — Configure two constant servers and swap between them anytime.
- 🛡️ **Auto-Fallback** — Automatically reconnect to your main server if you get kicked or disconnected.
- 🧩 **Mod Menu Integration** — Adjust all settings easily through the in-game Mod Menu interface.
- 💾 **Persistent Config** — Settings are automatically saved and reloaded on startup.

---

## 🖥️ Requirements

- [**Fabric Loader**](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
- [**Fabric API**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [**Fabric Language Kotlin**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
- *(Optional)* [**Mod Menu**](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) — for in-game configuration

---
